Our name

Why Meridian?

A meridian is a line of longitude running from pole to pole, used to describe a position on the globe.

The name reflects how we approach the challenge: looking across markets while keeping a clear reference point. Our strategic allocation gives us a starting portfolio against which to judge the changes we make in later rounds.
